criteria.evidence: Chat owns the last turn's outcome and its recovery commands (message/turn-outcome.ts, message/turn-commands.ts). Interborough's turn-states.ts, the rail footnote path (endsTheTurn, endLabel on ToolCalls, runFinishedNoReply copy and their tests), the Discard and Continue toasts, and the composer's second reconnect line are deleted. A turn that ends on its steps (tool calls only, narrated then tools, last call errored or refused) draws stopped, failed, empty or reconnecting through Chat's anchor after the steps, so its stop note and Retry are gone: chat-conversation-states.test.ts and chat-conversation-stopped.test.ts assert no .chat-note, one outcome, no footnote. Kept on purpose: the stop note with Retry for a failed turn that is the person's message alone (no step made, so no row to anchor after; chat-conversation-states 'a discarded turn keeps the plain stopped line' relies on it), and the Why it failed link on earlier failed attempts (row 20b, COR-2533). Interborough has no private CSS for the stop line or retry.

turn-commands.test.ts (57 cells), chat-turn-commands.test.ts, chat-turn-outcome-anchor.test.ts (3 call shapes by stopped/failed/empty, commands once, plus a dropped stream), turn-outcome-anchor.test.ts (3 shapes by 4 outcomes), chat-conversation-states.test.ts (Discard answered after a session switch, refused Discard inline, dropped run said once, Discard on a tool-only stopped turn sends run-states-ended-on-tool), chat-conversation-stopped.test.ts (setting refusal after a switch), chat-session-retry.svelte.test.ts, chat-session-reconnect.svelte.test.ts. Red against main at f429470056, 65e0b1ed23 and e9bdab71f4 (review F1: turn-outcome-turns.test.ts, 149 cells with the probe, and the route rows where Discard and Continue acted on the earlier reply's run; F2: a refused or throwing Retry now of a tool-only turn). Design review (R6 width, escalation design pass at 47bd044cf9): the anchor carries no role, so it missed the transcript rule that lifts the wrapper's max-width caps (base min(80%, 48rem), phone 95%) which only a reply matched; it clamped to 80% of the column (95% on phones). chat-message.svelte now lists the anchor beside the reply in the unlayered transcript rule (inline-size and max-inline-size 100%), and Try again takes margin-inline-start: auto in the empty row. A browser geometry test (components/chat/browser/tests/chat-turn-outcome-anchor.playwright.ts, not run here) measures the anchor against the column, the reply, the steps above it, and a user row as negative control, per kind, plus right to left; captures for the tool-only states added to chat-states.spec.ts. Round 3 (red at f486156d6f): what is said on an outcome anchor ends with it (the anchor releases its ledger entry when it unmounts), a command is drawn only in a state it fits (so a refused Retry now never shows once the same anchor is stopped, failed or empty), and the outcome row stands after the turn's last step and before a trailing follow-up (chat-turn-outcome-anchor.test.ts). The stop, the anchor and the carrier now come from one segmentation of the last turn, and a follow-up after the steps no longer moves the anchor. Bureau remains the source of run status and journal replay; the registry keeps workspace-scoped sessions; neither changed.
chat-message-turn-states.test.ts 'the caret is a 2 px bar in the accent colour' and turn-state.test.ts 'R2'; unchanged.

Chat draws R3 (chat-message-turn-states.test.ts, chat-turn-outcomes.test.ts). On the route, chat-conversation-states.test.ts 'a run whose stream dropped says so once' shows attempt X of Y, Next try and Retry now, with the composer count and the failure alert no longer repeating it; chat-turn-outcome-anchor.test.ts covers a dropped stream on a tool-only turn.
